       'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>')

    return ('<w:p><w:pPr/><w:r>' + RPR +

empty = '<w:p><w:pPr/><w:r>' + RPR + '<w:t xml:space="preserve"/></w:r></w:p>'

    empty,
    para('Based on Q4 2024 results and the Q1 2025 outlook, management '

    para('• Accelerate investment in Cloud Services and Enterprise '
         'Solutions, the two fastest-growing segments (+22.8% and +14.2% '
         'YoY), to sustain revenue growth above the 12.4% delivered in 2024.'),
    para('• Expand into international markets in Q1 2025 to support the '

    para('• Maintain Research & Development investment at 12.8% of '
         'revenue to support the new product launches planned for 2025.'),
    para('• Preserve cost discipline in Sales & Marketing and '
         'General & Administrative to keep operating margins above 22%.'),
    para('• Extend the customer acquisition and retention programs that '
         'drove the 8.3% reduction in acquisition costs and the 14.1% gain in '
         'customer lifetime value.'),
]

anchor = editor.get_node(tag='w:p', contains='mitigate these risks')
assert anchor is not None, 'anchor paragraph not found'

    nodes = editor.insert_after(nodes[-1], block)

XML_PATH = 'unpacked/word/document.xml'

RPR = ('<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" '
       'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>')


def make_para(text):
    t = '<w:t xml:space="preserve"/>' if text == '' else '<w:t xml:space="preserve">' + text + '</w:t>'
    return ('    <w:p>\n'
            '      <w:pPr/>\n'
            '      <w:r>\n'
            '        ' + RPR + '\n'
            '        ' + t + '\n'
            '      </w:r>\n'
            '    </w:p>')


paragraphs = [
    make_para('RECOMMENDATIONS'),
    make_para(''),
    make_para('The following recommendations build on the strong momentum delivered in Q4 2024 '
              'and address the opportunities and risks outlined in this report:'),
    make_para('• Prioritize investment in Cloud Services, the fastest-growing segment at '
              '22.8% year-over-year growth, to capture additional market share in Q1 2025.'),
    make_para('• Accelerate international market expansion to support the projected 10-13% '
              'revenue growth and reduce geographic concentration risk.'),
    make_para('• Sustain research and development funding near 12.8% of revenue to fuel the '
              'new product pipeline while protecting operating margins above 22%.'),
    make_para('• Diversify suppliers and extend currency hedging programs to mitigate the '
              'supply chain and foreign exchange risks identified above.'),
    make_para(''),
    make_para('Management recommends that the board adopt these priorities for the coming quarter.'),
]

with open(XML_PATH, 'r', encoding='ascii') as fh:
    xml = fh.read()

marker = '    <w:sectPr/>'
assert xml.count(marker) == 1, 'expected exactly one sectPr marker'

snippet = '\n'.join(paragraphs)
new_xml = xml.replace(marker, snippet + '\n' + marker, 1)

from defusedxml import minidom  # validate well-formedness before writing

parsed = minidom.parseString(new_xml.encode('ascii'))
body = parsed.getElementsByTagName('w:body')[0]
children = [c for c in body.childNodes if c.nodeType == c.ELEMENT_NODE]
assert children[-1].tagName == 'w:sectPr', 'sectPr must remain the last body element'
assert 'RECOMMENDATIONS' in new_xml

with open(XML_PATH, 'w', encoding='ascii', newline='\n') as fh:
    fh.write(new_xml)

print('Added recommendation section: %d paragraphs before sectPr.' % len(paragraphs))

read as text, new paragraphs (heading + bulleted recommendations) matching the
report's existing formatting (Helvetica Light, sz 24) are appended before the
final <w:sectPr/>, and the file is written back as ASCII XML.
"""
from pathlib import Path

DOC = Path("unpacked_report/word/document.xml")
xml = DOC.read_text(encoding="ascii")

RPR = (
    '<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" '
    'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>'
)


def make_p(text):
    """Paragraph with the report's standard run properties."""
    if text:
        t = '<w:t xml:space="preserve">%s</w:t>' % text
    else:
        t = '<w:t xml:space="preserve"/>'
    return (
        "<w:p>\n"
        "      <w:pPr/>\n"
        "      <w:r>\n"
        "        %s\n"
        "        %s\n"
        "      </w:r>\n"
        "    </w:p>" % (RPR, t)
    )


def bullet(text):
    return make_p("• " + text)


recommendations = [
    "Accelerate Cloud Services capacity expansion and international market entry "
    "to sustain the projected 10-13% revenue growth in 2025.",
    "Maintain research and development investment near 12.8% of revenue to "
    "support the new product launch pipeline.",
    "Extend the operational efficiency program that lifted the operating margin "
    "to 23.1% across all business units.",
    "Strengthen the hedging program and diversify key suppliers to reduce "
    "currency fluctuation and supply chain exposure.",
    "Keep disciplined expense management in place, holding general and "
    "administrative costs near 5.5% of revenue.",
]

fragment = [make_p("RECOMMENDATIONS"), make_p("")]
fragment += [bullet(r) for r in recommendations]
fragment.append(make_p(""))

anchor = "</w:p>\n    <w:sectPr/>"

    raise SystemExit("ERROR: trailing <w:sectPr/> anchor not found")

new_xml = xml.replace(anchor, "</w:p>\n" + "\n".join(fragment) + "\n    <w:sectPr/>", 1)
DOC.write_text(new_xml, encoding="ascii")

Pure standard-library edit (no docx library imports): the document.xml file is
read as text, new paragraphs (heading + bulleted recommendations) matching the
report's existing formatting (Helvetica Light, sz 24) are appended before the
final <w:sectPr/>, and the file is written back as ASCII XML.
"""
from pathlib import Path

DOC = Path("unpacked_report/word/document.xml")
xml = DOC.read_text(encoding="ascii")

RPR = (
    '<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" '
    'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>'
)


def make_p(text):
    """Paragraph with the report's standard run properties."""
    if text:
        t = '<w:t xml:space="preserve">%s</w:t>' % text
    else:
        t = '<w:t xml:space="preserve"/>'
    return (
        "<w:p>\n"
        "      <w:pPr/>\n"
        "      <w:r>\n"
        "        %s\n"
        "        %s\n"
        "      </w:r>\n"
        "    </w:p>" % (RPR, t)
    )


def bullet(text):
    return make_p("• " + text)


recommendations = [
    "Accelerate Cloud Services capacity expansion and international market entry "
    "to sustain the projected 10-13% revenue growth in 2025.",
    "Maintain research and development investment near 12.8% of revenue to "
    "support the new product launch pipeline.",
    "Extend the operational efficiency program that lifted the operating margin "
    "to 23.1% across all business units.",
    "Strengthen the hedging program and diversify key suppliers to reduce "
    "currency fluctuation and supply chain exposure.",
    "Keep disciplined expense management in place, holding general and "
    "administrative costs near 5.5% of revenue.",
]

fragment = [make_p("RECOMMENDATIONS"), make_p("")]
fragment += [bullet(r) for r in recommendations]
fragment.append(make_p(""))

anchor = "</w:p>\n    <w:sectPr/>"
if anchor not in xml:
    raise SystemExit("ERROR: trailing <w:sectPr/> anchor not found")

new_xml = xml.replace(anchor, "</w:p>\n" + "\n".join(fragment) + "\n    <w:sectPr/>", 1)
DOC.write_text(new_xml, encoding="ascii")
